title: Playbook triage + 1:1 prep (Avery)
content:
Meeting: weekly AE <> CSM triage
Date: 2026-03-12 10:00am PT (prep notes)
Attendees: Avery (AE), Rosa (CSM), Samir (SE) - quick sync after if needed
Goals for this 1:1:
- Align on top 6 accounts for Q2 expansion focus (who needs executive sponsor, who needs product deep-dive)
- Surface health risks early and lock next steps (demos, POC, exec intro)
- Triage open escalations / SLO issues impacting renewals

Quick agenda (15m):
1) Quick wins + wins-to-share (2m)
2) Account triage run (8m) - Acme / Nimbus / FernBank quick bullets
3) Escalations & product asks (3m)
4) Action items & owners (2m)

Top accounts (notes to self):
- Acme Logistics (ARR: $420k) -- risk: slow adoption of batching feature; health score slipped from 86 -> 61 last 30d.
  - Recent support ticket: JIRA-7412 (kv cache eviction bug) - Samir owning root cause analysis.
  - Ask Rosa: any scheduled executive touch? If not, propose CRO intro next week.
  - Quick ask: get list of top 5 active users + their product usage times (for adoption play).

- Nimbus Media (ARR: $95k) -- opportunity: want dedicated capacity for peak hours; exploring Dedicated pilot.
  - Action: draft pilot proposal + estimated monthly commit. TODO: pull cost model from pricing template (Confluence).
  - Risk: legal PCI questions delaying pilot. Rosa to check legal queue.

- FernBank (ARR: $1.1M) -- renewal in 90 days, healthy usage but price pushback expected.
  - Strategy: propose 12-month committed capacity with 10% discount in exchange for 6-week SLA extension.
  - Prep: compile latency/cost graphs for last 6 months (console export).

Open escalations / product asks:
- KV eviction (JIRA-7412) - high priority for Acme. Samir status: RCA in progress, ETA 3/14.
- Streaming mis-ordering for batch streams (internal ticket: JIRA-7555) - affects two small customers, need mitigation plan.
- Deployment rollback playbook unclear for Private on-prem minor releases - note to product: add to runbook.

Questions to ask Rosa in 1:1:
- Which accounts would you prioritize for exec outreach vs. technical touch? (ask for 3 names)
- Any top churn indicators you want more telemetry on? (list likely: drop in daily active model calls, spike in 5xx errors, billing disputes)
- Are there any customer meetings I should sit in next week?

Action items (explicit):
- Avery: send Acme exec intro proposal draft by 2026-03-13 EOD (owner: Avery)
- Rosa: confirm legal status for Nimbus pilot and share timeline by 2026-03-15 (owner: Rosa)
- Samir: post interim RCA note for JIRA-7412 and mitigation steps (owner: Samir) - due 2026-03-14
- Avery + Samir: export latency/cost graphs for FernBank renewal pack by 2026-03-17
- Rosa: schedule 30m customer health review with Acme champions (owner: Rosa) - tentative 3/18

Follow-up email template (quick draft to tweak after meeting):
Subject: Recap + next steps from today’s AE/CSM triage
Hi [Name],
Thanks for the sync — quick recap and owners below. Please flag anything missing.
- Acme: Avery to draft exec intro; Samir will post RCA for kv issue (JIRA-7412).
- Nimbus: Rosa to check legal queue for Dedicated pilot; Avery to prepare pilot cost doc.
- FernBank: Avery + Samir to share latency/cost pack for renewal discussion.
Next meeting: weekly triage same time next Friday.
Cheers,
Avery

Notes to self (talk track snippets):
- For Acme exec: focus on risk mitigation + timeline to fix the kv eviction (don’t overpromise root cause)
- For Nimbus: highlight Dedicated throughput guarantees and burst policy; avoid deep-dive on kernel internals unless SE asks
- For FernBank: lead with usage -> cost narrative; show concrete optimizations (batching + cache) that lower unit cost

Misc playground (ideas to try later):
- Playbook snippet: 5-step renewal salvage play (risk score > 60): 1) CE touch, 2) custom performance report, 3) pilot low-cost Dedicated window, 4) exec intro, 5) discount + SLA swap
- Quick checklist for 1:1: data exports done, tickets updated, customer comms drafted, stakeholder list up-to-date

End of prep. Keep this doc for quick edits during the meeting.
